**Finding: compliant** (RENEWAL — §§ 8.2–8.3, paragraphs p0033, p0034)

The renewal terms already sit at our preferred position, so no redline was proposed:

- **Renewal term:** successive twelve-month periods — no multi-year auto-renewal.
- **Non-renewal window:** thirty days' written notice by Customer (preferred is ≤ 30; fallback ≤ 60).
- **Reminder:** Vendor must remind Customer sixty days before renewal, and failure to do so extends Customer's opt-out deadline to thirty days after the reminder is received — slightly better than our preferred ask.
- **Price uplift:** capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase applied to prepaid periods.

§ 8.1 (three-year master term with Order Form survival) does not create an auto-renewal of the Agreement itself, so it raises no issue under this rule.
